evidence_policy: local, wan, and inference are distinct; no WAN packet capture means no L4 claim

observations.subject: ipv4-pmtud
observations.claim: In a three-namespace path with a 1400-byte constricting link, a 1400-byte IPv4 packet succeeded and a 1401-byte DF packet elicited Fragmentation Needed with MTU 1400; the sender route cache recorded MTU 1400.
limitations: This does not measure the WAN path

observations.subject: traceroute
observations.claim: UDP and ICMP traceroute in the temporary topology reported the router at hop 1 and destination at hop 2.

observations.subject: dhcp-tftp-integration
observations.claim: Existing self-generated frames 1-4 contain DHCP DISCOVER, OFFER, REQUEST, and ACK; frames 5-7 show the leased client address completing TFTP RRQ, DATA, and ACK for synthetic boot.img.

observations.subject: owned-vps-reachability
observations.claim: The registered owned IPv4 and IPv6 endpoints replied to echo, and the IPv4 endpoint accepted authenticated SSH during the observation window.

observations.subject: endpoint-mtu-state
observations.claim: The VPS reported eth0 MTU 1500 and an IPv6 connected-prefix route MTU of 1464.
limitations: Endpoint state is not an end-to-end PMTU measurement

observations.subject: pmtu-probes
observations.claim: Adjacent large echo probe sizes produced non-monotonic response results, so no WAN PMTU value was assigned.

observations.subject: udp-traceroute
observations.claim: A bounded UDP traceroute with one probe per TTL through 16 returned no matching replies while the endpoint remained reachable by ping and SSH.
limitations: Does not identify the suppressing hop or policy
Does not determine physical hop count

observations.subject: traceroute-capability
observations.claim: TCP and ICMP traceroute modes were not run because raw-socket operations were not permitted in the invoking environment.
limitations: A permission failure is not a network-path result

observations.subject: tcp-high-port-transfer
observations.claim: The client command returned success, but the remote application read zero bytes and the listener remained active at check time; delivery was not verified.

observations.subject: udp-high-port-transfer
observations.claim: The local UDP send command returned success, but the remote application read zero bytes; delivery was not verified.
limitations: Local send acceptance is not a delivery acknowledgment

observations.subject: pmtud-black-hole
observations.claim: Suppressed ICMPv6 Packet Too Big messages can allow a TCP handshake yet cause larger data transfer to hang.
limitations: Not reproduced on the WAN in this run

observations.subject: dhcp-client-integration
observations.claim: A captured DHCP option proves transmission by the server, not adoption by the client; client state and data-plane evidence are needed for adoption claims.
limitations: Implementation behavior must be checked separately
